eps.o: The Loud family and Clyde arrive for a fun-filled summer at Camp Mastodon, but Lincoln and Clyde quickly find themselves in a battle against the toughest bunk at camp.
At Camp Mastodon, Lynn pushes an overly-cautious Lisa to become more adventurous.

eps.t: Summer Camp: Don't Lose Your Cool
eps.o: When Lori learns her Camp Mastodon campers think she's uncool, she tries to impress them by breaking the rules.
When Lincoln and Clyde discover a centuries-old pirate flag, they accidentally awaken the ghost of a vengeful zombie pirate and his octopus sidekick.

eps.t: Summer Camp: Brawl of the Wild
eps.o: During a nature hike gone wrong, Leni clashes with a snarky co-counselor.
Lynn is excited for her Swiss friend Henrik to visit, but she grows nervous when people think they're more than friends.
Lincoln and friends start a shoveling business to raise money for David Steele on Ice tickets.
Lynn uses a crystal ball to see her future and then goes totally bananas trying to control what the future will be.
Lincoln, Clyde and Kara win a gaming contest put on by a streamer named Thumbz.
When Lori and Bobby find a kitten, they decide to co-parent and swap the kitten back and forth between their homes.
After telling her family how great her apartment is, Lori unknowingly entices her sisters to secretly take over her space.
When Mom and the twins win a raffle to spend a weekend at a resort, Lana struggles to leave her pets behind.
After Lincoln tests a magic trick on Grouse, they get handcuffed together and Grouse has to spend the day at middle school.
When Leni is put in charge of the school's prom, she is determined to make it the most memorable night ever.
Lincoln and Clyde cast Luan as the villain, Bee Trayal, in their David Steele film and have to deal with her method acting.
To earn her next patch and become a golden Snickerdoodle, Lola must spend quality time with Sunset Canyon senior, Bernie.
After Lynn sees cousin Shiloh's athletic skills, she gets overly competitive to prove she's the greatest Loud of all time.
Leni and Miguel's dating advice podcast takes a chaotic turn.
When Lincoln's spirited Gran Gran Myrtle spies a tell-tale tattoo on Boy Jordan's kindly grandmother during Grandparents Day, she launches a full-tilt mission to expose a long-vanished jewel thief.
Lori launches a desperate plan to prove she's winning her breakup by finding a new boyfriend before her social media reputation takes a hit.
When Rusty and Amber rekindle their romance, their plans are thrown into chaos when their business rival parents forbid the relationship.
Lori's barista job takes an exciting turn when she's invited to apply to a prestigious coffee university.
When Stella overhears her classmates calling her a "teacher's pet", she sets out to change her squeaky-clean image.
When Lori becomes the star of The Dream Boat to find her soulmate, a desperate Bobby goes undercover as a contestant to win her back from a "perfect" rival suitor.
To avoid his responsibilities, Lincoln uses Lisa's hologram device to make it appear like he's doing all of his tasks.
Leni and Luna accidentally wreck Gramps boat when their small viewing party gets out of control.
When it appears the kangaroo mascot Crikey has vandalized the school, The Action News Team tries to prove his innocence.
Lincoln finds ways to break a family rule about hand-me-downs so he can get Lori's old mattress instead of his sisters.
After struggling to relate to Shelby's interests, Lance tries to bond with her at a live-action role-play event.
Lana tries to save the town garbage man's job when she finds out the mayor is replacing him with an automated garbage truck.
After Luan pranks Grouse with a fake lottery ticket, she has to deal with the consequences of his massive shopping spree.
Lynn desperately searches for a popular brand of basketball shoes after she narrowly misses out on buying a pair.
While housesitting, Stella lets her friends use Principal Ramirez's pool on a super-hot day.
Luna and Luan get competitive when they find out they’re competing for the same performance grant.
Lucy struggles to come with ideas when she's given the opportunity to write an original story for the Royal Wood's Gazette.
With Mom busy at work, the Loud siblings are tasked with taking care of Dad when he overreacts to getting a cold.
